summary: 文体计量学通过词汇和表达习惯建立作者的统计特征，用来检验莎士比亚作品的署名。研究未给培根代笔说提供多少支持，却提出马洛可能参与部分早期戏剧；对古文本的处理仍使结论有争议。
logic: 从大量文本提取作者特征
评估代笔说及马洛合作说

paragraphs.brief: 即使在今天，在他去世近400年后，著名的英国戏剧家威廉·莎士比亚的作品并没有失去他们的吸引力，也没有关于他的天才来源的任何疑问。
sentences: Even today, almost 400 years after his death, the works of the famous English dramatist William Shakespeare have lost none of their appeal, nor have questions about the source of his genius.
即使在今天，在他去世近400年后，著名的英国戏剧家威廉·莎士比亚的作品并没有失去他们的吸引力，也没有关于他的天才来源的任何疑问。
For is it really credible that an ordinary actor from the small town of Stratford-upon-Avon should metamorphose into so extraordinary a dramatist?
因为一个普通的演员来自小城镇斯特拉特福德的阿文是否应该变成一个如此非凡的戏剧家？
For some, the answer is obvious: Shakespeare was a genius whose gift is no more suspicious than that of the physicist Albert Einstein, the German salesman's son who devised the theory of relativity.
对一些人来说，答案是显而易见的：莎士比亚是一个天才，其天赋并不比德国销售员的儿子、物理学家艾伯特·爱因斯坦的天赋更令人怀疑。
But others have insisted that a mere school leaver simply could not have penned such sophisticated works.
但其他人则坚持认为，仅仅一个辍学者根本无法将这种复杂的作品拼写下来。
They believe that Shakespeare was a pseudonym for someone with far more impressive qualifications who wrote the plays that still play to packed theatres today.
他们相信莎士比亚是一个化名一个人更令人印象深刻谁写剧本仍然在打包剧场今天。
But after long and largely fruitless debate, researchers are now turning to scientific methods to resolve the controversies surrounding Shakespeare.
研究者现在开始研究科学方法，解决莎士比亚的争议。
Ways of identifying the literary ‘fingerprint’ of writers are currently being developed using computers.
目前正在利用计算机开发确定作家文学 " 指纹 " 的方法。
This analysis of features of literary style is known as 'stylometry' and with it researchers can recognise the work of Shakespeare and his contemporaries with impressive reliability.
对文学风格特征的分析被称为“tylology”，研究人员可以以令人印象深刻的可靠性认识莎士比亚及其同龄人的作品。

paragraphs.brief: 使用这些基本科学技术来调查作者身份问题的想法可追溯到1851年，当时维多利亚数学家奥古斯都·德摩根建议，可以通过他们使用不同长度语言的频率来识别不同的作者。
sentences: The idea of using these basic scientific techniques to probe questions of authorship dates back to 1851, when the Victorian mathematician Augustus de Morgan suggested that different authors might be identified through the frequency with which they used words of different lengths.
使用这些基本科学技术来调查作者身份问题的想法可追溯到1851年，当时维多利亚数学家奥古斯都·德摩根建议，可以通过他们使用不同长度语言的频率来识别不同的作者。

His idea attracted the attention of Thomas Mendenhall, an American physicist who decided to use word length to investigate one of the oldest controversies about the works of Shakespeare: were they actually written by someone else?
他的想法吸引了Thomas Mendenhall的注意，一位美国物理学家决定用字长来调查莎士比亚作品中最古老的争议之一：它们是别人写的吗？

paragraphs.brief: 早在1785年伊丽莎白的作家和哲学家弗朗西斯·培根爵士被确定为可能的一个竞争者写了莎士比亚的作品。
sentences: As long ago as 1785, the Elizabethan writer and philosopher Sir Francis Bacon was identified as a possible contender for having written Shakespeare's works.
早在1785年伊丽莎白的作家和哲学家弗朗西斯·培根爵士被确定为可能的一个竞争者写了莎士比亚的作品。

Bacon's possible motivation for not wanting to be known as the author of such masterpieces is far from clear, but Mendenhall believed his methods might at least reveal telltale signs of Bacon's hand in the plays.
培根可能不想被称作这些杰作的作者，其动机还很不清楚，但门登霍尔相信他的方法可能至少暴露出培根手在剧本中的明显迹象。
However, his results, published in 1901, revealed Bacon's writing style to be quite unlike that of Shakespeare.
然而，他1901年发表的研究结果显示，培根的写作风格与莎士比亚完全不同。
But Mendenhall's methods also revealed some key concerns.
但门登霍尔的方法也揭示了一些关键的问题。

Recognising the need to include large samples of writing from both authors, Mendenhall lumped all their works together, despite the fact that literary style can vary enormously between plays, poetry and philosophy, for example.
门登霍尔认识到需要将两位作者的大量著作样本包括在内，因此将他们的所有作品拼凑在一起，尽管文学风格在剧本、诗歌和哲学等方面可能大不相同。
His focus on word length as the sole ‘fingerprint’ of writing style was also questionable - for how could he be sure that some other characteristics would not give different results?
他把字长作为写作风格的唯一“指印”也是值得怀疑的，因为他如何能确定其他一些特征不会产生不同的结果？
But Mendenhall’s biggest fault was perhaps simply that he was too far ahead of his time - he was attempting a task that cried out for the kind of computers not even conceivable over 100 years ago.
但曼登霍尔最大的错误或许只是他太早于时代 — — 他试图完成一个100多年前甚至无法想象的计算机的呼喊任务。
More recently with their development scholars have been able to look for subtle peculiarities among the complete works of authors, which, in Shakespeare's case, amount to over 800,000 words.
近来，随着这些工具的发展，学者已经能够在作者的全部作品中查找细微的独特用法；莎士比亚的全集就有 80 多万词。

paragraphs.brief: 莎士比亚与其他戏剧家的关系也成为了目前被调查的关键争议之一
sentences: One of the key controversies now being probed is Shakespeare's relationship with other dramatists.
莎士比亚与其他戏剧家的关系也成为了目前被调查的关键争议之一
Was he a lone genius or was his work the result of collaboration?
他是独创的天才还是合作的结果？
Traditional methods of investigating such questions have relied on traits like the use of metaphor, but these may be shared by different authors simply on cultural grounds.
调查这类问题的传统方法依赖于使用比喻等特征，但不同的作者可能仅仅基于文化理由而认同这些特征。
In contrast, modern stylometry focuses on far more fundamental characteristics which are less likely to be shared by others.
相比之下，现代的提法则侧重于远为更为基本的特点，而其他特征则不太可能被其他人所分享。
The text-crunching power of computers allows researchers to pinpoint phrases, words or even individual letters by their frequency in the work of different authors.
计算机的文字拼接功能使研究人员能够根据不同作者的工作频率，确定短语、单词甚至单字母。
Pattern recognition techniques are then used to develop a ‘fingerprint’ for each author.
然后使用模式识别技术为每个作者开发一个 " 指纹 "。

paragraphs.brief: 说莎士比亚教育程度太低无法创造出持久的美貌。
sentences: Stylometry has come up with little to encourage the continual number of experts who insist Shakespeare was simply too uneducated to create works of enduring brilliance.
说莎士比亚教育程度太低无法创造出持久的美貌。

In 1996, literary scholar Ward Elliott and mathematician Robert Valenza of Claremont McKenna College, California, published the results of a stylometric comparison of the works of Shakespeare with those of over 30 of the proposed 'real' authors.
1996年，加州Claremont McKenna学院文学学者Ward Elliott和数学家Robert Valenza发表了莎士比亚作品与30多名“真人”作者作品的文体比较结果。
Elliott and Valenza applied a battery of 51 tests to computerised texts and found that none of the claimants had a stylometric ‘fingerprint’ similar to that of Shakespeare.
Elliott和Valenza对计算机化文本进行了51次测试，发现没有一个索赔人具有与莎士比亚相似的 " 指纹 "。

“I think these claims were driven initially by a sense that Shakespeare is too ‘important’ to be an ordinary person,” says Professor Kate McCluskey, director of the Shakespeare Institute at the University of Birmingham.
说凯特·麦克卢斯基教授伯明翰大学莎士比亚研究所主任：“我认为这些主张最初的动机是莎士比亚太"重要"了无法成为普通人。”

paragraphs.brief: 一些最早的剧本，特别是亨利六世和臭名昭著的暴力的提图斯安卓尼科斯，似乎是莎士比亚和他的杰出的当代人剧作家克里斯托弗·马洛的结合，他生于莎士比亚同年。
sentences: Elliott and Valenza's research found something else too.
艾略特和瓦伦扎的研究也发现了别的东西

Some of the earliest plays, notably Henry VI and the notoriously violent Titus Andronicus, seem to be a combination of Shakespeare and his brilliant contemporary the playwright Christopher Marlowe, who was born in the same year as Shakespeare.
一些最早的剧本，特别是亨利六世和臭名昭著的暴力的提图斯安卓尼科斯，似乎是莎士比亚和他的杰出的当代人剧作家克里斯托弗·马洛的结合，他生于莎士比亚同年。
'Traditional scholars accept that Marlowe influenced Shakespeare's early work,' says Dr Thomas Merriam, one of Britain's leading stylometry experts.
托马斯·梅里亚姆博士英国主要的音量学专家之一：“传统学者承认马洛影响了莎士比亚的早期工作。”
He explains that, provisionally at least, stylometric studies suggest some of Marlowe's actual text exists within the early plays of Shakespeare.
他解释说，至少暂时来说，台词学研究表明马洛的一些实际文字存在于莎士比亚早期的剧本中。

paragraphs.brief: 有些学者对将莎士比亚职业生涯的新观点建立在对数百年的文字进行字典分析的基础上，仍然持谨慎态度。
sentences: Some scholars remain cautious about basing new views of Shakespeare’s career on stylometric analysis of centuries-old texts.
有些学者对将莎士比亚职业生涯的新观点建立在对数百年的文字进行字典分析的基础上，仍然持谨慎态度。
“If they have been edited, amended or shortened, then the data from them is highly compromised,” says Dr Markus Dahl of London University.
伦敦大学的Markus Dahl博士说，“如果编辑、修改或缩短，那么它们提供的数据就会大为失密”。
Even so, the results to date are in line with the growing view of Shakespeare as a hardworking professional who perfected his skills throughout his career.
即便如此，迄今为止的结果也符合莎士比亚日益被视为一个辛勤工作、在整个职业生涯中完善其技能的专业。

items.en: uncertainty why an author would wish to remain anonymous
items.zh: 作者为何希望保持匿名的不确定性
items.why: 文中说培根若真写了这些杰作，为何不愿署名仍不清楚，正对应匿名动机存疑。

items.en: a reference to the continuing popularity of Shakespeare's work
items.zh: 莎士比亚作品持续流行的提法
items.why: “持续受欢迎”= lost none of their appeal。只有 A段开头在讲当下热度。

items.en: the reasons why a particular researcher's approach proved unsatisfactory
items.zh: 某一研究人员的做法被证明不能令人满意的原因
items.why: 这位研究者只把词长当作作者指纹，其他风格特征却可能给出不同结果，因而方法受质疑。

items.en: mention of the time when the use of stylometry was first proposed
items.zh: 提及首次提议使用tytyllogy 的时间
items.why: B段将分析文体来判断作者的提议追溯到1851年，并注明提出者为德摩根。

items.en: support for the opinion that Shakespeare became more skillful as he grew older
items.zh: 支持莎士比亚长大后变得更有技巧的观点
items.why: “越来越娴熟"= perfected his skills. 其他段未正面评价其生涯曲线。

items.en: a similarity between Shakespeare and a scientist with exceptional ability
items.zh: 莎士比亚和科学家的相似之处
items.why: 作者把莎士比亚与爱因斯坦并列，说明两人都可凭非凡天赋取得成就。

items.en: It has always been uncertain whether he worked in ________ with others or not.
items.zh: 他是否曾与他人________创作，一直没有定论。
items.why: 回到对应内容“他是独创的天才还是合作的结果？”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Current stylometric analysis has been made possible by the invention of ________.
items.zh: ________的发明使现代文体计量分析成为可能。
items.why: “使当代分析成为可能的发明”= 计算机。与 invention of computers 语法吻合。

items.en: By using stylometric analysis of particular characteristics and pattern recognition systems, a so-called ________ of a writer can be identified.
items.zh: 通过分析特定的文体特征并运用模式识别系统，可以识别出一位作家所谓的“________”。
items.why: “所谓的_“= 文中术语 fingerprint (文体“指纹”)。
items.solution: 指纹（此处指独特的文体特征）

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: People search for a more distinguished author because they cannot accept that a normal individual could write such brilliant plays.
items.zh: 人们寻找一个更杰出的作者因为他们不能接受一个正常人能写出如此出色的剧本

items.en: It should be possible to recognise writers by examining the number of letters in the words they use.
items.zh: 应该能够通过审查作者所用字眼中的字母数量来识别作者。

items.en: The fact that Shakespeare's works are likely to have been altered over the years raises doubts about any stylometric analysis.
items.zh: 莎士比亚的作品多年来可能已经改变这一事实令人怀疑任何的音量分析。

items.en: Analysis proves that Shakespeare's style differs from those of writers who have been suggested as the authors of the plays.
items.zh: 分析证明莎士比亚的风格不同于那些被推荐为剧本作者的作家
items.answer: B · Ward Elliott and Robert Valenza
items.solution: 沃德·艾略特和罗伯特·瓦伦扎

points: 文中说培根若真写了这些杰作，为何不愿署名仍不清楚，正对应匿名动机存疑。
回到对应内容“他是独创的天才还是合作的结果？”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: “that a mere school leaver simply could not have penned such sophisticated works”补足 insisted 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 insisted 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
But Mendenhall’s biggest fault was perhaps simply that he was too far ahead of his time - he was attempting a task … not even conceivable over 100 years ago.
“that cried out for the kind of computers”修饰前面的 task。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 task，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Experts suggest 'Shakespeare' may have been a pseudonym - a pen-name – for another writer.
专家认为"Shakespeare"可能是另一个作家的假名笔名。
vocabulary: 利用语言统计特征比较文体
